beats.say: Tell a secret to two friends, and in twenty one rounds, the whole planet knows.
Everyone who knows tells two new people, so the number triples every round. Round five: two hundred and forty three.
Round eleven: a hundred and seventy seven thousand. More than a packed Michigan Stadium.
Round sixteen: forty three million. All of Canada.
Round eighteen: three hundred and eighty seven million. Everyone in the United States.
Round twenty one: over ten billion. Every person alive on Earth.
Three more rounds, and it's more than everyone who has ever been born. About a hundred and seventeen billion people.
And here's the wild part: nearly seven percent of all humans ever born are alive right now.

title: Tell 2 friends a secret. In 21 rounds, all of Earth knows
caption: Everyone who knows tells 2 new people, so the count triples each round (3 to the power of the round). Round 5: 243. Round 11: 177,147, more than Michigan Stadium holds (107,601). Round 16: 43,046,721, more than Canada (41,798,407 on July 1, 2026). Round 18: 387,420,489, more than the United States (341.8 million). Round 21: 10,460,353,203, more than everyone alive (about 8.2 billion). Round 24: 282,429,536,481, more than everyone ever born (about 117 billion, Population Reference Bureau). And nearly 7% of all humans ever born are alive today. Real gossip overlaps and stalls, but the math is why it spreads so fast.
